notes:
# Guard this Mac {shield}
Leaving your Mac on while you're away? Turn on Guard this Mac and the
camera watches for someone at it. Your phone gets an alert with their
picture. Turn it on from the RecordLah! menu, Settings › Guard, or your phone.

# Watch the camera from your phone {iphone}
While it's guarding, tap Watch camera on your phone to see the room live,
and Pictures to see everyone who came. Pictures only: nothing is heard.

---

Everything else in this release:

- The first time you turn it on, allow the camera on your Mac. For alerts
  that get through Focus modes, allow Time Sensitive notifications for ntfy
  on your iPhone.
- Guard alerts and breakout room changes each have their own switch under
  Settings › Alerts.
- After an update, your phone can reach your Mac again within seconds.
